# naiveproxy v154.0.8037.49-5 (github.com/klzgrad/naiveproxy, the release's naive binary for linux-arm64),
# HTTP/3 to a recording QUIC proxy that answers every CONNECT 200 with `padding-type-reply: 1`:
#   naive --listen=socks://127.0.0.1:18080 --proxy=quic://user:pass@127.0.0.1:18443
#   curl --socks5-hostname 127.0.0.1:18080 http://exampleN.test/   (N = 1, 2, 3, one after another)
# The client's unidirectional streams, control-stream frames and CONNECT requests as the recorder

# packet per line, from the server's qlog. naiveproxy's GET before each CONNECT is left out with its
# fields and its PRIORITY_UPDATE frames; its stream ids are the gaps (0, 4, 8 hold CONNECTs 4, 8, 12).
